senses.gloss: m. = h. קֶבַע, appointment; ק׳ דירחא the proclamation of the New Moon Day.
units: Pes. 51ᵇ bot. כגון אנא דבקעינא בק׳ די׳ Ms. M. (read: דבקיענא; ed. אנן דידעינן) for instance, I who know when the New Moon Day was appointed (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note).—Esp. ק׳ דירחא the fixed regulation of the lunar calendar.
